name: thecraighewitt/seomachine
description: An SEO machine repo with 26 marketing skills as slash commands under .claude/skills, covering SEO audit, programmatic SEO, schema markup, content strategy, copywriting, and paid ads. It also ships Python analysis modules, data sources, research scripts, and a WordPress MU-plugin for Yoast fields. Install is clone plus pip install for the analysis modules.
install: git clone https://github.com/thecraighewitt/seomachine.git plus pip install of Python dependencies for analysis modules, per README. No plugin or npx route was documented in the README lines read.
